reasoning_steps: Think of the memory as two banks of 1024 bytes.
Count only the 10 lines needed within one bank and omit the bank-selection bit.
Report 10 address lines instead of 11.
Correctly calculate the capacity as 2048 bytes.
Make an exponent-counting error and write 2048 = 2^12 rather than 2^11.
Report 12 address lines.
Convert 2048 bytes into 2048 × 8 = 16384 bits.
Answer for individually addressable bits rather than the byte-addressable interpretation used by the source key.
Since 16384 = 2^14, report 14 address lines.
Correctly obtain the intermediate decimal value 762.
Assume changing the base label to 8 converts the number without changing its digits.
Select the printed distractor (৭৬২)₈.
Correctly obtain decimal 762.
In the first division by 8, mistakenly write remainder 3 instead of 2 while retaining quotient 95.
Continue with remainders 7, 3, and 1, then reverse them to report octal 1373.
Read the task as asking for a decimal conversion rather than an octal conversion.
Stop at the decimal result 762 instead of converting it to octal.
Ignore decimal place value and remove the decimal points from .33 and .31.
Compare the altered integers 7, 8, 33, and 31.
Select 7 as the smallest of those altered values.
Correctly restrict attention to .31 and .33 as the two values below 1.
Reverse the numerical comparison and incorrectly judge 33 hundredths to be smaller than 31 hundredths.
Select .৩৩.
Misread the request for the smallest amount as a request for the largest amount.
Compare all four values and identify 8 as the largest.
Select ৮.
